smoke_selection.rule: Per TRAIN and VAL, sort reusable exact-R0 full-candidate inputs by (RGB SHA256,id), take first4; total8; no prediction/pose error/rank outcome used.

camera_and_labels.source_symmetry_rule: Use DIMENSION_SIDECAR per-frame symmetry_order (C1/C2), not unconditional C2 from old selector addnorm. UNKNOWN->C1 is conservative contract, not independent physical symmetry verification.
camera_and_labels.source_truth: Existing renderer GEOMETRY_SIDETABLE R,t,Xcf,K,dims; not GT reconstructed from model predictions
camera_and_labels.rotation: min acos((trace((R_reference_runtime @ Q).T @ R_candidate_runtime)-1)/2), Q in declared source C1={I} or C2={I,Ry(pi)}, degrees; real evaluation retains existing object C2.
camera_and_labels.whole_pose_label: Score each whole candidate from one parent+W/D using its own centroid AND rotation. Do not concatenate minimum T with minimum R or use source parity label alone to pick a parent.

C1_perfect_input_limitation.interpretation: Existing camera-facing candidate contract does not resolve signed yaw for this C1 source. Keep faithful C1 loss; no label/permutation change, no row exclusion, not a full-pose perfect-GT PASS for C1.

adapter.R0_input: Read existing prepared RGB once, no additional reflect border; canonical640 rect=True conf=.001 augment=False half=False batch1.
adapter.old_full_cache: For each candidate add100 to stored keypoints_xy and box_xyxy; preserve score/keypoints_conf/order/selected_index. Existing native-subtracted JSON is authoritative.
adapter.refiner: CORE.predict(model, prepared_BGR, prepared_coordinate_R0_prediction, cap_fraction=None); predicted bbox only, expansion1.25; never SourceData.item or annotation target.
adapter.output: Prepared pixel coordinates for all model views; same padded K and unchanged physical dimensions for candidate generation.
adapter.source_canvas_limitation: Source prepared RGB includes reflection border while real CORE input is native RGB; calibration domain difference remains, do not silently change source canvas.

status_scope: Input integrity and adapter/projection parity pass, but C2 perfect-coordinate exhaustive pose check has one existing solver anomaly (G38__G__f26406). Investigation pending; no neural forwards or new training.

fit_eligibility.rule: All existing DIMENSION_SIDECAR declared symmetry_order==2 TRAIN and VAL records; no per-instance error or model-output filter. Both R0-only control and whole-pose union use the identical subset.
fit_eligibility.C1_qualification: UNKNOWN->C1 is a conservative metadata declaration, not independent physical asymmetry verification. Signed-yaw correspondence under the current camera-facing API remains unresolved.
fit_eligibility.scope: Source ranker calibration applies to the declared C2 task; no C1/asymmetric-object claim. C1 diagnostics may not be used to tune this run.
fit_eligibility.perfect_coordinate_check_role: Check all eligible rows for a common geometry/axis implementation defect; check failure must stop the adapter, never remove a failing individual row.

C2_all_eligible_perfect_coordinate_check.correct_branch_rule: Xcf edge 0->1 is camera-facing width; compare to Xcf edge 0->4 depth before pose solve. Not selected by outcome.
C2_all_eligible_perfect_coordinate_check.reference: R_runtime_reference=R_table@diag(1,-1,-1); t_reference=t_table; declared C2 rotations I and diag(-1,1,-1).

C2_solver_anomaly_diagnostic.improper_matrix_note: The cuboid-to-Xcf map has determinant -1. Sending R_table@A into Rodrigues does not define a physical reference rotation; the reported Rodrigues attempt is diagnostic only. Ground truth remains table.R and table.t with the documented source basis.
